newsitem.title: USA: Security Capital interest gain helps Q2 net.
newsitem.headline: Security Capital interest gain helps Q2 net.

text.p: Security Capital Corp said on Thursday that an increase in net interest income, combined with lower non-interest expense, helped fuel a 67-percent gain in net income in the second quarter.

The company reported net income of $14.0 million in the period, up from $8.3 million one year ago. Net interest income totaled $32.0 million, up from $28.6 million last year, Security Capital said, while non-interest expense fell to $16.3 million from $47.5 million one year ago.
Security Capital is the parent of Security Bank. Its shares were trading up two Thursday at 72.
